content.comment_body: [product_name] [version_no] with [product_name] [version_no]: I’m unable to access the reference function or link the analog comparator with the up/down counter. The reference button is missing compared to other hardware selections. I urgently need this feature to program 6 temperature sensors using [product_name] [version_no].
Why did you post in the topic 'Counter value with analog comparator,' and then create a new topic for the same question? Was the initial response not quick enough?

How can I upload an image here? See the picture—when selecting [product_name] [version_no], the reference function isn’t available. I tried other functions but nothing worked. I suspect there may be a hardware issue with [version_no].
Did you read the previous answers?

I initially asked because someone had implemented this and I thought I was doing something incorrectly. Later, I suspected it might be a bug not just related to my issue—so I expanded the question for broader feedback. I now see a possible solution and will investigate further. If you think this discussion isn’t helpful, feel free to remove it. Others in the same situation may find it useful. Solution provided here thanks to [user_name]: [url]

No, I don’t think your post is pointless, just redundant. You asked your question in another topic first, then again in your own thread. If you had reviewed [user_name]’s answer immediately, you wouldn’t have needed to create a new post. I’ve already given the correct solution via another link. Instead of checking my previous reply, you asked again in an additional topic.
